name: KaneAI
description_en:
KaneAI is a product in the Software testing category. Its directory profile covers Geo Location Testing, Live Web Testing, Bug Tracking, Seamless Integration, Test Recorder, Cross Device Testing, Reporting and Analysis, Scheduling.

Additional listed capabilities include Cross Browser Support, Debugging, Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: record software defects and follow their progress; allocate times for appointments, resources or tasks; work with supported browsers in a common workflow; inspect program execution to investigate faults; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
KaneAI 属于软件测试软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括地理位置测试、在线网站测试、缺陷跟踪、集成能力、测试录制工具、跨设备测试、报表与分析、排程管理。

资料还列出跨浏览器支持、代码调试、访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：记录软件缺陷并跟踪处理进展；为预约、资源或任务安排时间；在同一流程中使用受支持的不同浏览器；检查程序执行过程以定位故障；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: The legacy lambdatest.com/kane-ai and pricing routes explicitly redirect to testmuai.com. This batch already contains a TestMu AI platform record with identity_domain testmuai.com; the shared schema requires unique registered domains and same-domain official sources. Completing this KaneAI subproduct record would either duplicate identity or require false legacy URLs. Neither was done; the coordinator must resolve product-versus-platform identity support.
research_gaps.zh: 原 lambdatest.com/kane-ai 及价格入口明确跳转 testmuai.com。本批已有 identity_domain 为 testmuai.com 的 TestMu AI 平台记录，共享模型要求注册域唯一且官方来源同域。完成 KaneAI 子产品会重复身份或需要虚假旧 URL，本次均未做；需协调方解决子产品与平台身份支持。

research_gaps.en: Actual authoring, code generation, run-instance, credits and FAQ originals were read. Authoring capture runs steps as added; paused manual interactions are not recorded. Execution errors block dependent steps and differ from false assertions. New authoring/reporting views are request-enabled or early-access rather than universal. No application was opened or test authored.
research_gaps.zh: 已读编写、代码生成、运行实例、信用额度及 FAQ 原页。编写捕获会执行新增步骤，暂停时手动交互不录入；执行错误会阻断依赖步骤，与断言为假不同。新编写／报告视图需申请或处于抢先阶段，并非普遍可用。本次未打开应用或编写测试。

research_gaps.en: Code generation needs a test saved Ready; generated code can enter a full Test Run even without a successful Sample Run. Exported scripts depend on listed public bindings. Instance replay shows steps, variables and errors and can be shared publicly. No generated code, dependency, test, share link or CI job was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 代码生成需要测试保存为 Ready，生成代码即使未通过 Sample Run 也可进入完整运行。导出脚本依赖所列公共绑定。实例回放含步骤、变量及错误，也可公开共享。本次未执行生成代码、依赖、测试、共享链接或 CI。

research_gaps.en: The current annual display lists Starter $17/month for local CLI authoring and 2,000 credits/agent/month; Pro $89 adds cloud web authoring and 100 HyperExecute minutes, while Max $179 adds cloud mobile and 300 minutes. Credits, concurrent authoring and execution minutes are separate allowances. The credit guide uses one organization wallet and dated batches; actual checkout and plan enforcement were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 当前年付显示 Starter 月均 $17，含本地 CLI 编写及每 Agent 每月二千额度；Pro $89 加云网页编写和一百 HyperExecute 分钟，Max $179 加云移动端和三百分。信用额度、编写并发及执行分钟是不同额度。信用指南按组织共用钱包及有期限批次管理，本次未测试结账或套餐执行。
